about: The Hansa as it is in Cargo 1: the convoy office that carries ships between the stars, charges dues every ten turns and sells bonds that lower them (cargo.py: Game.collect_dues, handle_hansa); the ports' broker robot; what people say about both. The charter (main.json) is the convoy office becoming a league with its own money.

port_broker.name: TALLY-4
port_broker.about: the ports' broker robot: quotes prices at other docks with more confidence than it has earned

rumour.dues_board.title: Rumour: dues board
rumour.dues_board.text: They say your name is up on the convoy office board. Not the good board.

rumour.bondholder.title: Rumour: bondholder
rumour.bondholder.text: A young hauler asks you, quite seriously, whether it is true you own a piece of the convoys. You do, technically. About the size of a door.

gossip.dues.title: Gossip: dues
gossip.dues.text: The convoy dues went up again. The convoy master says it is the price of safety. The haulers say it is the price of the convoy master's new hat.

gossip.convoy.title: Gossip: convoy
gossip.convoy.text: Forty ships in the Gamma convoy this week and one tug at the back that keeps falling asleep. The convoy master says it is a scheduling feature.

gossip.bonds.title: Gossip: bonds
gossip.bonds.text: An old captain says Hansa bonds are the only thing that ever went up on this station apart from the rent.

gossip.price_bot.title: Gossip: price bot
gossip.price_bot.text: {port_broker} got the agri price at Delta right to the credit last week. It has mentioned this to everyone since, twice.

gossip.dumping.title: Gossip: dumping
gossip.dumping.text: Somebody sold six hundred tons of tech at Gamma in one go and the price fell through the floor. The dock is still sweeping it up.
